chunks.head: all at once
chunks.note: 表示某事毫无预兆地、突然发生，等于 suddenly。

literal.note_cn: 此处无独立含义，须整体记忆

chunks.ex_en: All at once the room went dark.
chunks.ex_cn: 突然间，房间黑了下来。

chunks.head: can't be too careful
chunks.gloss: 再小心也不为过；越谨慎越好
chunks.note: “can't be too + 形容词”是固定句式，意为“再怎么…也不算过分”。

literal.note_cn: 此处与 can't 连用表“再…也不为过”

chunks.ex_en: When you cross a busy road, you can't be too careful.
chunks.ex_cn: 过繁忙的马路时，再小心也不为过。

chunks.head: keep out of
chunks.note: keep out of sth 指置身事外、不去招惹某事或某地。
chunks.ex_en: Please keep out of my room when I'm not home.
chunks.ex_cn: 我不在家时，请别进我的房间。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: 表示不经常、间或发生，等于 occasionally。

literal.note_cn: 习语固定用词，不作字面解

chunks.ex_en: Now and then we go fishing by the lake.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们时不时会去湖边钓鱼。

chunks.head: give up
chunks.note: 指停止做某事或交出、舍弃某物。本章指放弃一处宝藏不再挖。
chunks.ex_en: Don't give up so easily—try one more time.
chunks.ex_cn: 别这么轻易放弃，再试一次。

chunks.head: in a little while
chunks.note: while 此处为名词，指“一段时间”。
chunks.ex_en: Wait here—Mom will be back in a little while.
chunks.ex_cn: 在这儿等着，妈妈过一会儿就回来。

chunks.head: cut off
chunks.note: 指把某物切开分离，或阻断退路、联系等。本章指截断退路。
chunks.ex_en: The flood cut off the village from the main road.
chunks.ex_cn: 洪水把村子和主路隔断了。

chunks.head: in a low voice
chunks.note: 描述说话音量很小；low 此处指“(声音)低的”。
chunks.ex_en: She spoke in a low voice so the baby wouldn't wake.
chunks.ex_cn: 她低声说话，免得吵醒宝宝。

chunks.head: in full view
chunks.gloss: 完全暴露在视线中；一览无余
chunks.note: 常作 in full view (of sb)，指在某人眼前、毫无遮挡地被看到。
chunks.ex_en: The kids played in full view of their teacher.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们就在老师眼皮底下玩耍。

chunks.head: hear from
chunks.note: hear from sb 指收到某人的来信、来电或音讯。
chunks.ex_en: I hope to hear from you soon.
chunks.ex_cn: 希望很快收到你的消息。

chunks.head: drop into
chunks.note: drop into a place 指临时、随意地去某处。
chunks.ex_en: I'll drop into the shop on my way home.
chunks.ex_cn: 回家路上我会顺便去趟商店。

chunks.head: take one's chances
chunks.note: 明知有风险仍决定一试，听天由命。
chunks.ex_en: There's no umbrella, so I'll just take my chances in the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 没伞了，我就冒雨碰碰运气吧。

chunks.head: in an instant
chunks.note: 强调事情发生得极快。
chunks.ex_en: In an instant the cat vanished under the bed.
chunks.ex_cn: 转眼之间，猫就钻到床底下不见了。

chunks.head: on one's knees
chunks.note: 表示双膝着地的姿势；也可引申为哀求。本章为字面义。
chunks.ex_en: He got on his knees to look under the sofa.
chunks.ex_cn: 他跪下来往沙发底下看。

chunks.head: never mind
chunks.note: 用来叫对方不必担心、不用管某事。

literal.note_cn: 此处为“不要”的加强语气

chunks.ex_en: Never mind the mess—I'll clean it up later.
chunks.ex_cn: 别管那些乱七八糟的，我等会儿收拾。

chunks.head: make quick work of
chunks.gloss: 迅速解决；三下五除二搞定
chunks.note: 指很快、利落地把某事做完(也说 make short work of)。
chunks.ex_en: The hungry boys made quick work of the pizza.
chunks.ex_cn: 饿坏了的男孩们三两下就把披萨吃光了。

chunks.head: shake one's head
chunks.gloss: 摇头(表示否定或不赞成)
chunks.note: 左右摇头，常表示“不、不同意”或困惑。
chunks.ex_en: She shook her head and said no.
chunks.ex_cn: 她摇了摇头，说不行。

chunks.head: stand by
chunks.note: 指做好准备、随时听候差遣。也有“支持某人”之义。本章为“待命等候”。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“待在一旁准备着”

chunks.ex_en: Stand by—the doctor will call your name soon.
chunks.ex_cn: 请稍等，医生很快会叫到你的名字。

chunks.head: take someone for
chunks.gloss: 把某人误认为…；把某人当作…
chunks.note: take sb for sb/sth 指错把某人看成别的人或东西。
chunks.ex_en: In the dark she took me for my brother.
chunks.ex_cn: 黑暗中她把我错当成了我哥哥。

chunks.head: slip out
chunks.note: 指不引人注意地离开某处。
chunks.ex_en: He slipped out of the meeting to make a call.
chunks.ex_cn: 他悄悄溜出会议室去打电话。

chunks.head: be absorbed in
chunks.note: 指全神贯注、入了迷。本章指两个男孩满心都是懊恨。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“全神贯注、入神的”

chunks.ex_en: He was so absorbed in his book that he missed the bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 他看书看得太入神，错过了公交车。

chunks.head: keep a lookout for
chunks.gloss: 留心提防；守望着(等某人/某物出现)
chunks.note: 指警觉地注意、防备某人或某事出现。
chunks.ex_en: Keep a lookout for the mailman while I finish this letter.
chunks.ex_cn: 我写完这封信，你帮我留意着送信的人。

chunks.head: occur to someone
chunks.note: 指想法、念头忽然出现在心里。occur 此处非一般“发生”义。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“(念头)忽然出现”，非一般“发生”

chunks.ex_en: It suddenly occurred to me that I'd left the door open.
chunks.ex_cn: 我突然想起门还开着。

chunks.head: think over
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(thought it all over),故 card-only。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“从头到尾、仔细地”

chunks.ex_en: Take a day to think over my offer.
chunks.ex_cn: 花一天时间好好考虑我的提议吧。

chunks.head: turn up
chunks.note: 本章 turn up 指用铲子把埋着的东西翻出;出处为分离式(turned it up),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: The dog turned up an old bone in the garden.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只狗在花园里刨出了一根旧骨头。

chunks.head: get into a scrape
chunks.note: scrape 此处指“困境、麻烦”;本章出处被 awful 隔开,故 card-only。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“窘境、麻烦”，非“刮擦”

chunks.ex_en: The boys got into a scrape for breaking the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 男孩们打破了窗户，惹上了麻烦。

chunks.head: look over
chunks.note: 指从头到尾地看、审视一遍;本章出处为分离式(looked it over),故 card-only。

literal.note_cn: 此处指“仔细地、整体地(查看)”

chunks.ex_en: The teacher looked over my homework and smiled.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师把我的作业仔细看了一遍，笑了。

skipped: Injun Joe / Robin Hood / Cardiff Hill / Number Two / Texas (专名/人名)
warn't / ’twon't / ’tain't / t'other / a body (方言拼写)
milksop / brick / nobby / swag / pard (俚语/一次性)
deaf and dumb (dumb=哑,今属过时/冒犯说法)
leg it / dead for sleep (方言俚语)
bear a hand (过时习语,今用 lend a hand)
hove ... in / betook ... homeward (古旧文学用法,一次性)
under the happiest auspices (文学性一次性)
by the great Sachem (一次性感叹语)
I bet / I'll bet (口语常见但表面形不一,控量舍去)
come of it (较冷僻,控量舍去)
be about to (偏基础/语法化)
